decision: No English deadline arm qualifies; no English confirmation or default change.
limitations: E2B is a harness label; actual CPU Whisper-small and Marian CT2 finals, no Gemma.
All runs have six eligible fixed source anchors; nearest-rank tail is the maximum here, not an eligible p95 claim. Never pool runs, languages or arms to reach n>=100.
Complete machine VAD/source ledger and zero file capture loss do not certify microphone reliability or acoustic truth.
Public development read speech with unchanged unreviewed references; human/bilingual meaning and visible-browser/device certification remain pending.
Only retained JSON, source and stdlib computations were used; no native imports, models, tests, audio/device calls, Git or weight reads.
